<thought>To determine the number of methyl groups, I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample. Methyl groups appear as singlets (or sometimes doublets/triplets) around 0.8–1.2 ppm with integration corresponding to three protons each. By counting distinct methyl signals in the spectrum, I can report the total number of methyl groups.</thought>
